key_highlights: ASX slumps sharply as miners and banks sell off; oil hovers near US$100 amid prolonged Trump-Iran conflict
AUD faces a 'shocker' as stronger yen and oil-driven current account pressure weigh on the dollar
Iron ore trouble spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX and broader materials sector
Australian business conditions weakest since pandemic, signalling broad-based economic softening
High-end property prices decline while affordable segment remains resilient; NSW stamp duty revenue hit
WA gold miners (AUR.AX, GDR.AX, FRT.AX, GTP.AX) active with new discoveries and drill-outs amid gold boom
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
Power giant proposes AI data centres at coal plant sites; NSW energy supply adequacy questioned

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off; iron ore weakness spreads while gold miners benefit from safe-haven demand and WA exploration activity
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from iron ore softness and Chinese inflation concerns; gold names (AUR.AX, GDR.AX, FRT.AX, GTP.AX) outperform on gold boom and new discoveries

sectors.trend: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX sharply lower; private credit stress (Bathla) and weak business conditions raise credit-risk concerns
sectors.implications: NIM compression risk if RBA holds; private credit contagion could hit non-bank lenders; housing downturn threatens mortgage book quality

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran conflict; gas reservation policy shift under Albo; data-centre power demand strains grid
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike; AGL.AX, CSG.AX, GPT.AX face policy uncertainty on gas; energy transition disrupted by AI data-centre load

sectors.trend: High-end residential prices falling; NSW stamp duty revenue hit; property chiefs call for more migrant builders
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals; construction names (WBC.AX, CGW.AX) may see volume support from supply push

sectors.trend: Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; AI data-centre buildout at coal sites; global tech (AMD, MU, AMAT) strong on AI capex
sectors.implications: AUS.AX M&A activity; data-centre power demand creates utility upside but strains energy transition

key_themes: Oil at US$100 from Iran conflict drives risk-off, pressures importers, boosts energy producers
AUD 'shocker' risk from yen strength and oil-driven current account deterioration
Iron ore demand weakness linked to Chinese inflation and property slowdown
Gold super-cycle supports WA miners; multiple new discoveries and offtake deals
Housing bifurcation: luxury segment correcting, affordable end resilient
Private credit market stress post-Bathla collapse
Energy transition vs AI data-centre power demand tension
Business conditions at pandemic lows signal potential RBA policy pivot

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price sustained above US$100 (Iran conflict escalation)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); reduce consumer discretionary and transport exposure
Overweight export-oriented miners and energy; underweight import-dependent retailers (WES.AX, LOL.AX); consider AUD short via FX

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand deterioration / Chinese property slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper (copper demand structural)
Avoid leveraged credit funds; favour listed bank equities with strong capital buffers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction (high-end) and stamp duty revenue loss
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor REIT valuations; favour affordable-housing and construction plays over luxury developers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW energy supply adequacy / data-centre load
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight AGL.AX, GPT.AX, CSG.AX on structural power demand; monitor AEMO capacity warnings

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold miners on discovery pipeline and gold price strength
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (GDR.AX, AUR.AX), new offtake deals (FRT.AX), and US$45M drill-out funding (GTP.AX) signal sector upcycle; gold benefits from oil-driven inflation and safe-haven flows

opportunities.recommendation: Add domestic energy producers on US$100 oil
opportunities.rationale: Sustained Iran conflict supports oil; WDS.AX and WLE.AX benefit from higher realised prices; SXG.AX gains from LNG demand

opportunities.recommendation: Position for RBA rate cut on weak business conditions
opportunities.rationale: Business conditions weakest since pandemic (NAB/BIS index); Only Fans masking unemployment; rate cut supportive for banks, REITs, and growth equities

opportunities.recommendation: Copper exposure via Flagship and global names
opportunities.rationale: Flagship ups Canadian copper stakes; copper structural demand from electrification and data centres offsets iron ore weakness

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreading; Chinese inflation and property slowdown threaten demand; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD downside and reduce import-dependent consumer names
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'shocker' risk from yen strength and oil import bill; WES.AX, LOL.AX, IAG.AX face margin compression

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid private credit and leveraged fund exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals contagion risk in alternative credit; prefer listed, regulated financials

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight luxury property and high-end REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; NSW stamp duty hit signals policy response; affordable segment more resilient

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil at US$100, iron ore weakness, and AUD depreciation create a risk-off backdrop. Gold miners and energy producers are relative outperformers. RBA may signal a cut given pandemic-low business conditions, providing a partial offset. Volatility elevated on Iran conflict headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and RBA cuts. Structural themes: gold super-cycle, copper/electrification demand, AI data-centre power buildout, and housing supply response. Key risk is prolonged Iran conflict keeping oil elevated and delaying rate cuts. Chinese property recovery trajectory is the swing factor for iron ore and broader materials.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (business conditions at pandemic lows)
Iran conflict resolution or escalation (oil trajectory)
Chinese property and inflation data (iron ore demand)
NSW and federal housing/stamp duty policy changes
AEMO energy capacity warnings and data-centre approvals
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
Chinese CPI/PPI and property sales data
AEMO capacity and NSW energy supply adequacy
